items.text: Latest answered decisions from round 2 were incorporated into plan.md: (d1) violation prioritization — fix long_files first by line count descending, then complex_functions by size descending; (d2) skip TypeScript 'as' cast fixes entirely, focus lint effort on .golangci.yml and CRITICAL comments only. Implementation strategy now reflects the long_files-first prioritization with GCT checkpoints after each phase.

Two decisions from round 2 remain unanswered: (d3) mid-phase GCT scoring checkpoints — the plan currently assumes checkpoints after each phase (recommended option A) but the user has not confirmed; (d4) golangci-lint severity configuration — the plan assumes minimal config with funlen + cyclop + gocognit (recommended option A) but the user has not confirmed. These are low-risk gaps since the plan already uses the recommended defaults; execution can proceed and adjust if the user provides different answers later.

Readiness assessment: problem_clarity (3) — fully understood with specific violation counts and file-level analysis; scope_defined (3) — acceptance_allow set, in/out scope clearly delineated including explicit exclusion of 'as' cast fixes; approach_solid (2) — concrete phased strategy with prioritization order, but two unanswered decisions (checkpoints and lint config) leave minor ambiguity; testable (2) — test cases identified per phase with GCT checkpoints, but checkpoint frequency depends on unanswered d3; risk_awareness (2) — key risks documented with mitigations, but no detailed rollback strategy if refactoring causes subtle behavioral changes.

plan_updates: Incorporated round-2 answered decisions: added violation prioritization order (long_files first, then complex_functions by size), updated scope to exclude TypeScript 'as' cast fixes, added GCT checkpoints to each phase in implementation strategy and rollout checklist, updated lint configuration references to specify minimal config (funlen + cyclop + gocognit), removed 'pnpm lint' from Definition of Done since UI lint fixes are conditional.
